text: Black photographer Chris Washington travels to upstate New York for a weekend with the family of his white girlfriend, Rose. Her parents are warm in a way that never quite rings true, the Black staff behave eerily, and a gathering of wealthy white guests [quietly bids on his photograph|threat|the powerful and their systems]. When Rose's psychiatrist mother [stirs a spoon in a teacup|images|household objects and machines], Chris confesses [the night his mother died|wrong|an accident and its guilt] and drops into [the sunken place|rules|it gets inside you], his body paralysed while his mind falls through a dark void.
